lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr2Mg12Bi2 (SrMg6Bi) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Bi and Sr each have 12 Mg neighbors, while Mg centers show 12 neighbors with mixed Bi/Mg/Sr coordination, with neighbor distances from roughly 3.00 to 3.24 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
